name: Action Required
description: What the viewer still has to read and acknowledge. By default every pending item across the tenant with a button per row; can also list the tagged pages of one space with Acknowledged or read time, show due dates from a due- tag, and add tasks each viewer ticks off with Done.

appspaceApis.label: List tagged pages in a Space
appspaceApis.name: getTaggedPages

appspaceApis.label: Get my acknowledgment of a page
appspaceApis.name: getPostAcknowledgment

appspaceApis.label: Read my preferences (where ticked-off tasks are kept)
appspaceApis.name: getPrefs

fields.name: scope
fields.label: What to list
fields.description: Waiting for me: everything the viewer still has to acknowledge, from any space. Pages of one space: the pages of the space below, acknowledged or not.

fields.name: spaceId
fields.label: Space ID
fields.description: The ID at the end of the space's address. With Waiting for me it is optional and only keeps items from these spaces (separate several with commas); leave it empty for every space.

fields.name: tag
fields.label: Only with this tag
fields.description: For example must-read. Leave empty for every item.

fields.name: showCompleted
fields.label: Keep acknowledged pages in the list
fields.description: Acknowledged pages stay and say Acknowledged.

fields.name: tasks
fields.label: Tasks
fields.description: Things every viewer should do once, next to the pages. Each viewer ticks a task off with Done; it then stays off their list.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Task
fields.description: For example: Confirm your emergency contact.

fields.name: note
fields.label: Line under it
fields.description: For example: Takes one minute. Leave empty to show the due date.

fields.name: linkUrl
fields.label: Link
fields.description: Where the task is done: a page, a form or another system.

fields.name: dueDate
fields.label: Due date (YYYY-MM-DD)
fields.description: Optional. Sorts the task among the other items.

fields.name: layout
fields.label: Look
fields.description: Cards: picture, title and a button per item. List: a quiet list with a line under each title.

fields.name: subtitle
fields.label: Line at the top
fields.description: Leave empty to hide it.

fields.name: buttonLabel
fields.label: Button label
fields.description: Label on each row's button (Cards), or the line under a page waiting for the viewer (List).

fields.name: showReadTime
fields.label: Show read time
fields.description: Worked out from the page's word count.

fields.name: readLabel
fields.label: Read time label
fields.description: {minutes} becomes the read time.

fields.name: wordsPerMinute
fields.label: Reading speed
fields.description: Words per minute used for the read time.

fields.name: showDueDates
fields.label: Show due dates
fields.description: A page tagged due-2026-10-09 is due on 9 October; items are then sorted by due date.

fields.name: dueLabel
fields.label: Line under a page with a due date
fields.description: {date} becomes the date from the page's due- tag.

fields.name: dueTagPrefix
fields.label: Due date tag prefix
fields.description: Change it if your tags use another word.

fields.name: acknowledgedLabel
fields.label: Acknowledged label
fields.description: Shown on a page the viewer has acknowledged.

fields.name: emptyText
fields.label: When nothing is waiting
fields.description: Shown when the list is empty.
fields.default: You have no items that require acknowledgment.

fields.name: maxItems
fields.label: Maximum items to show
fields.description: Maximum number of items to load. Up to four are visible at once; additional rows scroll inside the list.

fields.name: acknowledgeUrlTemplate
fields.label: Acknowledge URL template (optional)
fields.description: Override link for the button. Use {postId}, {origin}, and {type} placeholders. Leave blank to build a console deep link from post type.

fields.name: debugMode
fields.label: Diagnostic mode
fields.description: Shows a technical panel under the widget: settings as read, every API call and its result. Turn off before publishing.
